what_it_means: AgentBench starts timing the HTTP request and sends the prompt plus nvext metadata.
code_snippet:
start = time.perf_counter()
status, response_json, error = post_json(...)
failure_meaning: The harness did not produce request rows, so the run cannot be tied back to prompt/hint metadata.

what_it_means: Dynamo frontend tokenized/preprocessed the request while preserving request context and hints.
failure_meaning: Frontend runtime logs were missing or did not show preprocessing for this run.

what_it_means: Dynamo frontend handed the preprocessed request to the router/worker path.
failure_meaning: Frontend runtime logs did not show the request being dispatched toward the worker path.

what_it_means: Dynamo worker received the request before generation starts.
failure_meaning: Worker runtime logs did not show the request entering the decode handler.

what_it_means: Worker extracts the routed top-level priority value when that path is enabled.
failure_meaning: No request-level priority evidence was found. This can be expected when top-level priority is disabled.

what_it_means: Worker forwards the routed priority into the live SGLang generation call.
failure_meaning: The run did not expose worker/SGLang priority evidence. Check precise attribution and SGLang priority markers.

when: Worker attaches to SGLang request id
what_it_means: SGLang produced a request id, allowing Dynamo request rows to join with SGLang runtime events.
failure_meaning: The worker did not expose an SGLang request id, so SGLang events cannot be safely joined to the request.

what_it_means: Instrumented SGLang emits priority/cache events when the patched runtime path executes.
failure_meaning: No SGLang priority/cache event was observed. Check transfer logging and precise SGLang overlay.

what_it_means: Worker logs final usage, cached-token evidence, finish reason, and request context.
failure_meaning: Worker runtime logs did not show request completion.

what_it_means: Frontend observed the final response chunk and logged completion.
failure_meaning: Frontend runtime logs did not show stream completion for the request.

what_it_means: AgentBench records latency, prompt hash, hint metadata, cached tokens, and status.
failure_meaning: Request CSV rows are missing status or latency fields.

when: Postprocess maps logs to report columns
what_it_means: Postprocessing parses runtime logs and collapses them into public matrix fields.
failure_meaning: The matrix is missing or does not contain usable Exp9 rows.
